note: The bands the NRJ plant has to land in, from docs/DLG-STAGE1.md, which derives each from published figures for OA Composites' NRJ and the F3K class (scripts/dlg-derive.js prints the derived figures). Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

d1_glide.source: L/D at 5.2 m/s, derived 16.46 at 5.13 m/s, the best glide; Lindinger's 'sink rate approx. 0.3 m/sec' at the best glide's speed is 17

d2_min_sink.source: the least sink over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 0.283 at 4.56 m/s; Lindinger 'approx. 0.3', van Empel and Volkers 0.30 computed with thermal camber and 0.38 flat (their 240 g Stream NXT, 0.36 at the NRJ's 213 g), 0.25 to 0.38 measured

d3_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 4.35; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 0.95 / 5.657, of the zero lift line

d4_roll.source: full aileron from the harness pilot's glide asked for 8 m/s, the peak in the first 0.4 s: the helix angle pb/2V, which is the same at any speed, derived 0.265 on the manual's 13 mm, 163 deg/s at 8 m/s

d5_launch.source: the top of the zoom over the grass, thrown with the sticks centred, in each mode: Lindinger's 'experienced pilots can reach 60m', the throw the table is derived to (41 m/s, dlg-derive.js D5)

d6_release.source: the table's throw: let go where it lay, facing the way it faced, 70 deg up at 41 m/s with its CG 1.5 m over the ground, after one turn of 1.6 m radius at a constant angular acceleration, 2 x 2 pi r / V = 0.4904 s

d7_zoom_drag.source: the height the zoom gains over the height it would gain with no drag, V^2 / 2g: derived 0.69 (58.5 of 85.7 m), the drag across the Reynolds numbers; a constant CD0 at the glide's 0.024 would give about 0.5

d8_drag_re.source: CD at the zero lift line, one step: 0.024 at 5 m/s, the reference; at 40 m/s over at 10 m/s the root of 10 / 40, a laminar skin's Re^-1/2; at 2 m/s the floor at half the reference, 0.024 sqrt 2

d9_thermal.source: circling at 35 deg and 6 m/s centred on the 2.5 m/s thermal A: the rise at the circle's 5.2 m radius, 2.43, less the turn's sink, 0.43, derived 2.00

d10_still.source: the same circle where the air is still: the turn's sink, derived 0.434

d11_topped.source: the same circle over the thermal's top, 300 m: the still air's sink again

d12_no_motor.source: full throttle and closed throttle fly the same glide bit for bit: no thrust, no current, nothing turning, from the stick that on every other plane is the motor

d13_belly.source: a glide onto the grass comes to rest on its belly: the plant's hull_hz_down, the drawn pod's belly (src/render/dlgcraft.js DLG_DIMS.vHalfDown), within 4 mm

d14_cross_host.source: the NRJ's recorded discus launch, glide and thermal, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome
